title: Hoodmaps Day 1 video: transcript is unrelated Rinse FM radio audio
summary: The supplied transcript for this "Building a Startup in 4 Days: Hoodmaps: Day 1" video contains only a UK radio show (Rinse FM, Swamp 81, Hung Over with Jade Aia) with music and shout-outs. Pieter Levels never speaks, so no principles on building, launching or growth can be extracted.
